svg.desc: Setup step layouts. Each data-fixture names the exact representative. Theme, locale, selection and fixed-connection content reuse these layouts. Nested connection frames share the body with their standalone counterpart; method and ready have separate forms because their controls differ. OAuth approval is inline in source-approval.
